decisions.statement: The transpiler is this repository's own checkout rather than an installed copy.
A caller may name the checkout rather than leave the checkout to be worked out.
Every build loads the same plugins in the same order.
A plugin is named by an absolute path.
Where the compiler's program and each plugin sit is asked of the index.
The compiler's program and each plugin are found by the id each page carries.
Where the compiler's own folder sits is asked of the index as well.
The checkout a caller names is joined to a place under the compiler's own folder.

definition: the command line that runs the TypeScript to Lua transpiler over one project
